sam (AE): FYI — NimbusBank wants to run a POC to replace RivalAI. their checklist: prompt parity, streaming chunking differences, content-filtering behavior, and enterprise security sign-off. tagging se/eng to scope the work.
noor (SE): good call. do we have examples of RivalAI's streaming chunks? they break mid-sentence and include meta tokens. we should capture a few real streams.
sam (AE): they'll share a batch of production prompts tomorrow. also requested a draft plan for a shadow-rollout so they can keep fallback to Rival during parallel testing.
ryan (Eng): for streaming we'll need to adapt our chunk boundaries and replicate their delivery semantics (chunk ids + finalization marker). doable with a small proxy that munges events.
noor (SE): for prompt parity i want to run a confusion matrix across their top 50 prompts comparing label/intent outputs, not just raw text similarity. propose measuring: intent_match_rate, semantic_similarity (SBERT), and tokenizer_token_delta.

vika (Solutions): cost angle: if we run both systems for the POC at scale, expected token overhead + ingestion roughly +12-18% depending on normalization passes. if we add post-processing to force Rival-like punctuation it could go higher.

sam (AE): security: they need our completed infosec questionnaire + a sample VPC peering diagram. ops-bot, can you surface the latest enterprise packet link? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Uploaded: Nimbus_Enterprise_Packet_2026.pdf to /shared/sales/nimbus/ (link: https://files.redwood/nimbus/nimbus_packet_2026.pdf) :white_check_mark:

ryan (Eng): also flag: RivalAI uses a different tokenizer (byte-level variants) and injects invisible control tokens for formatting. those invisible tokens change token counts and sometimes prompt truncation. we'll need a mapping layer or a pre-tokenize & translate step.

noor (SE): suggestion: two-phase approach — 1) Shadow proxy that mirrors Rival requests to both backends and collects results, 2) Small normalization engine that re-runs outputs through light postprocessing rules to reduce delta. if still off, consider fine-tuning a small redwood-variant on their prompt/response pairs.

vika (Solutions): timeline idea: day 0 collect prompts + streams, day 1-2 stand up shadow proxy + run 5k prompt samples, day 3 crunch metrics and propose remediations, day 4 demo to Nimbus with fallback plan and cost delta.

sam (AE): client asked whether we can do traffic-splitting by route and fall back per-route to Rival if parity < 90% for that route. is that supported?

ryan (Eng): yes, we can implement per-route traffic routing and a health check that flips routes back to Rival temporarily. will need to track customer metadata for billing and legal sign-off for dual routing.

noor (SE): here's minimal smoke harness pseudocode to run locally against both endpoints — run 100 prompts and compute token delta + similarity: ```bash
# smoke harness
for f in prompts/*.json; do
  curl -s -X POST https://rival.example.com/v1/generate -d @"$f" > rival_out.json
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @"$f" > redwood_out.json
  python tools/score_pair.py rival_out.json redwood_out.json >> results.csv
done
```

vika (Solutions): metrics to output: route, prompt_id, rival_tokens, redwood_tokens, sbert_sim, edit_distance, streaming_chunk_mismatch_count.

sam (AE): action items: - sam: collect sample prompts + Rival API contract (due tomorrow noon) - noor: set up shadow proxy template and scoring harness - ryan: prototype streaming adapter + tokenizer mapping doc - ops-bot: confirm enterprise packet uploaded to shared folder

ops-bot: Confirmed: network diagram + sec questionnaire available at https://files.redwood/nimbus/ (checksums in packet).

ryan (Eng): one more note: if Nimbus uses Rival's content filters to mute outputs, we need to check policy differences; that can cause functional deltas that are not fixable via post-processing. call that out in the POC scope.

noor (SE): agreed — will include a quick policy comparison matrix in the POC deliverable.

sam (AE): perfect. i'll lock in a demo slot for day 5 with Nimbus stakeholders. will update this thread with the prompt bundle when they send it. :rocket:
